verdict.rationale: AnyDesk's REST API retrieves account data from my.anydesk, and its official open-source Python module can export session data to CSV, an open format. That makes this a real but narrow first-party export path, limited to session data. Missing for 10: a documented full-account or bulk export (address book contents, settings, users/roles, client configs), open-format export beyond session-history CSV, a documented account-closure or data-portability process, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The **AnyDesk REST API** lets you automate the retrieval and management of account data from the [my.anydesk I](http://my.anydesk.com/login) management console.
Export session data (to terminal or CSV)
You can use the API to integrate AnyDesk data with third-party systems, for example, to automate billing or collect session logs.
List the names and IDs of all Address Books associated with your license
